title: Correct reference
purpose: Correct a mistyped chain-of-custody reference for this order and every sample linked to it, retaining the earlier reference.

items.label: Chain of custody reference
items.description: Required different reference, up to 120 characters, trimmed on saving.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required correction explanation, at most 4000 characters.

sections.title: Actions and rules
paragraphs: An issued snapshot containing any sample on the order locks this path; changing draft scope does not remove the lock. The original report and receipt remain available; this path does not support released metadata correction. A client submission retains the reference exactly as entered by the client. Reprint affected paperwork/labels as needed. Concurrent order changes are refused; reload and compare the current reference. Form errors retain submitted text.

items.label: Correct reference
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators save the new order reference with attributed old/new values and return to the order.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the order without saving.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological reference corrections with actor, time, reason and old/new reference.
